thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P0: Metering emitter latency spike + token-count divergence detected for prod (delta > 8%). Automatic alerting triggered. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/metering-emitter|metering-emitter>
oncall-ryan: taking this. pinging eng-sre + billing. details?
alex-sre: seeing the same on dashboards — emit latency spiked ~10:22 UTC, emit success rate dropped, then a burst of retries. counts diverged between `tally_v1` and `shadow_agg`.
jamie-billing: >40 customers currently have overage flags in staging of the alerting pipeline, some are showing phantom spikes. Not yet auto-charged but support is getting tickets.
sara-eng: logs show repeated 503s from proxy svc during 10:21:50-10:27:10. sample log:
```
2025-06-01T10:22:03Z emitter[pid=44]: POST /emit -> 503 proxy-service
2025-06-01T10:22:03Z emitter[pid=44]: retrying id=abc123 seq=42
2025-06-01T10:22:04Z emitter[pid=44]: POST /emit -> 200
```
sara-eng: note: some retry attempts lack idempotency header `x-emit-id` because of a short-circuit in the client backoff path.
priya-ml: that would explain dup counting — emitter retries recorded as new tokens when dedupe header missing.
oncall-ryan: mitigation plan: 1) pause billing alerting & auto-charge triggers, 2) flip emitter to dedup-only mode (no retries), 3) start a limited backfill from reliable ingress logs for 10:20-10:30 window, 4) notify support/customers.
alex-sre: running `./ops/pause-billing-alerts.sh --incident 1758882468` now.
jamie-billing: confirmed pause: billing alerting set to "suppressed" for 60m (owner: jamie-billing). created support note template and started outreach to teams in CAC list.
support-bot: Created ticket INC-2025-456 in Incident Tracker; linked to this thread.
sara-eng: kicked off backfill job: `k run backfill-metering --from=2025-06-01T10:20:00Z --to=2025-06-01T10:30:00Z --mode=dedup` — job id bf-1758882468; tailing logs.
priya-ml: run quick checksum: `SELECT count(*) FROM shadow_agg WHERE ts BETWEEN '2025-06-01T10:20' AND '2025-06-01T10:30'` vs `tally_v1` to estimate divergence. running now.
alex-sre: found config rollback candidate: commit 9f1c2a3 changed `emit_retries` default from 2 -> 0 and disabled `x-emit-id` in a hotfix at 10:20 UTC. reverting to canary.
sara-eng: deploying a hotfix to emitter client: PR <https://git/repo/pull/482> restores idempotency header on retry path. rolling to canary in us-east-1.
jamie-billing: customer impact: preliminary count shows ~42 customers got overage flags, mostly small accounts. none billed. recommendation: suppress charges for affected window and send targeted email after reconciliation.
oncall-ryan: owners: eng-sre (alex-sre) = infra & pause, eng-runtime (sara-eng) = backfill + patch, billing (jamie-billing) = suppress & customer comms, ml (priya-ml) = verification. please add any blockers.
alex-sre: can confirm billing suppression applied and will revert once reconciliation completes. ping me for re-enable.
sara-eng: backfill job bf-1758882468 progress: 120/370 segments processed, checksums roughly matching slow path but diverging by ~7% so far. continuing.
priya-ml: checksum diff after 50% done: `diff_count = 6.9%`. looks like duplicates rather than missed emits.
oncall-ryan: decision: keep alerts suppressed, keep hotfix canary for 30m, continue backfill. plan full reconciliation and re-enable billing after manual signoff. ETA for reconciliation: ~3h.
alex-sre: also scheduled a short bridge at 11:00 UTC for post-mitigations — invite sent to eng leads + billing + support.
jamie-billing: drafting customer note: "We detected a transient metering issue that caused temporary overage flags. We're reconciling counts and suppressing any charges for the period. We'll follow up with corrected statements and an incident summary." will post to status.redwood once we confirm reconciliation.
sara-eng: patch landed to canary and promoted to 10% traffic; no further 503/retry anomalies in canary logs for 6m.
priya-ml: running final validation suite against canary results and backfill snapshot. looks good so far.
oncall-ryan: next actions: 1) let backfill finish, 2) complete diff and fix discrepancies, 3) sign-off from billing, 4) re-enable alerts and close incident. please update INC-2025-456 with findings.
support-bot: Incident INC-2025-456 updated: state=mitigating, severity=P1, owners=[alex-sre,sara-eng,jamie-billing].
jamie-billing: note: do NOT trigger auto-invoices for the affected window until reconciliation marked done. I've flagged billing pipeline.
alex-sre: I reverted the config on canary and queued a full rollback for 10%->100% after signoff.
sara-eng: backfill complete. final diff: 1.2% residual divergence, primarily rounding and late arrivals. creating reconciliation job to merge deltas.
priya-ml: validation pass: counts within acceptable threshold <1.5%. recommend re-enable alerts and clear flags.
oncall-ryan: re-enable billing alerts at 11:58 UTC after jamie confirmation.
jamie-billing: re-enable complete. will run audit to confirm no charges. support teams to review outstanding tickets.
alex-sre: tagging for postmortem: root cause = hotfix removed idempotency header on retry path + transient proxy 503s. action items: stronger canary checks for idempotency headers, add e2e test for emit dedupe, alert when `x-emit-id` missing, docs update.
priya-ml: adding regression test to eval suite.
jamie-billing: closing customer comms task; final email drafted.
oncall-ryan: closing bridge in 10m. thanks everyone.
alex-sre: :thumbsup:
jamie-billing: thanks team :heart:
sara-eng: good catch on logs. closing my tasks.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-456 updated to resolved (monitoring) at 1758882830.
